document: T21 compact artifact volume upper bounds and layered proof strategy

policy.ordinary_ci: Consumes only compact receipts with input/output content hashes. Must not read raw GT6 dumps, fetched corpora, or full-replay artifacts.
policy.hash_fast: Streams pinned blobs and validates sizes/SHA-256. Used for CI pre-submit validation.
policy.full_replay: Re-parses all source rows. Owned exclusively by --source-replay suite. Same raw corpus has exactly one canonical full-replay owner.

t21_operand_reachability_compact.basis: Contains unreachable_operand_recipes_all list (~11,111 entries) plus reachable_identities list (~2,163 entries). Upper bound set at 2x current size to allow growth within T21 scope.

t21_template_denominator_compact.basis: 93,133 denominator units with classification metadata. T13 compact artifacts are in the KB range because they only store counts/hashes; T21 carries per-unit classification for fidelity tracking. Upper bound at 12 MB accommodates the full T21 denominator with per-unit metadata.

gt6_mixer_templates_index_compact.basis: 3,414 authored template units with support/membership data. Required for immediate family load projection. Upper bound at 11 MB.

t21_source_denominator_compact.basis: Source row diagnostic — input-touch mapping and rejection data. Marked DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY in policy; not a closure numerator. Upper bound at 9 MB.

compact_total_upper_bound_basis: Sum of individual artifact upper bounds rounded up. The T21 compact portfolio is ~30 MB currently; the 42 MB ceiling provides headroom for the remaining T21 cards (T21-H through T21-M).

clean_checkout_verification.method: Delete all local raw/cache/fetched-source paths before running ordinary CI builders. Each builder's proof_tier determines expected behavior: compact builders must PASS, rederived builders must PASS, full_replay builders are SKIPPED.
clean_checkout_verification.t21_operand_reachability_status: proof_tier=compact, reads only committed resource trees and material definitions. Clean-checkout compatible by design.

ci_assertions.rule: Each compact artifact must be under its declared upper_bound_bytes.
Sum of all compact artifacts must not exceed compact_total_upper_bound_mb MB.
Ordinary CI path must not read from gt6_dump/, build/t13-gt6-source/, or fetched external corpora.
Each raw corpus has exactly one canonical full-replay owner. Multiple builders replaying the same source rows is a hard error.
